name: mlp-9-62-exact
author: claude-routine
description: Two hidden layers (9, 62) trained from scratch with Adam (cosine LR, 2000 epochs), then fine-tuned with misclassified images weighted 9x (Adam, lr 1e-3, cosine decay, best-state tracking) until all 70k MNIST images are classified correctly. 8,315 parameters, below the 8,335 of mnist/mlp-9-63-exact.
